page_title: STR 1-1 ANG | Strasbourg v Angers 15/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+3' It's like he was asking for a caution. Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) receives a yellow card.
90+3' Angers take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+3' Jordan Lefort (Angers) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Angers.
90+2' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
90+1' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Angers are going to take it.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the left post.
87' None of the Angers players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

87' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Angers have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
86' Substitution. Sebastian Nanasi makes way for Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg).
85' Yahia Fofana leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg).
84' A cross from Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Strasbourg will take a corner kick.
83' Himad Abdelli (Angers) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
82' There's an opportunity for Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
79' Problems for Alexandre Dujeux as Carlens Arcus (Angers) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Lilian Rao-Lisoa replaces him.
73' Substitution. Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) has come on for Jean-Eudes Aholou.
72' Here's the change. Ismael Doukoure leaves the pitch and Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) comes on as a substitute.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) comes onto the pitch so that Habib Diarra can be given a rest.
72' Here is a change. Jim Allevinah is going off and Alexandre Dujeux gives the last tactical orders to Zinedine Ferhat (Angers).
72' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Farid El Melali.
70' The resulting set piece from Strasbourg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
67' The main referee, Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) is given a yellow card for dissent.
65' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows a yellow card to Florent Hanin (Angers), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
62' 1 - 1 It's 1:1! Florent Hanin feeds Bamba Dieng (Angers) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
59' Himad Abdelli (Angers) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
57' Jim Allevinah (Angers) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play and Angers have been awarded a corner kick.
54' A terrific attempt by Himad Abdelli (Angers) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.
52' Farid El Melali (Angers) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
50' The resulting corner, taken by Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg), comes to nothing.

50' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
47' Himad Abdelli (Angers) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
46' Himad Abdelli (Angers) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' The foul by Farid El Melali (Angers) was seen by Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
40' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
40' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.
40' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the crossbar! A few inches lower and it could have been a sweet goal!
39' What a sweet touch by Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Yahia Fofana to hold.
36' The resulting corner from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) comes to nothing.

36' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The ball is out of play and Strasbourg manage to earn a corner.
35' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

35' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the bottom left corner, but it wasn't dangerous and Yahia Fofana made a comfortable save. Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
33' Yahia Fofana makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) after a cross from the side.
31' 1 - 0 Dilane Bakwa provides Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
28' Haris Belkebla (Angers) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem who sees an offensive foul.
20' Farid El Melali (Angers) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
19' Jim Allevinah (Angers) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Good work from Angers as they win a corner.

16' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Yahia Fofana anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
10' Jim Allevinah (Angers) takes the corner but it's cleared.
8' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Yahia Fofana to dive and make a save.
7' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Strasbourg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
5' Farid El Melali (Angers) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
4' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows a yellow card to Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) for a tough tackle.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Strasbourg will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem.
